title: This is what happens when you reply to spam email
speaker: James Veitch

sentences.en: A few years ago, I got one of those spam emails.
sentences.zh: 几年前，我收到了一封垃圾邮件。

sentences.en: And it managed to get through my spam filter.
sentences.zh: 它成功地通过了我的垃圾邮件过滤器。

sentences.en: I'm not quite sure how, but it turned up in my inbox, and it was from a guy called Solomon Odonkoh.
sentences.zh: 我不太清楚是怎么回事，但它出现在我的收件箱中，而且是来自一个叫所罗门·奥登科的人。

sentences.en: (Laughter) I know. (Laughter) It went like this: it said, "Hello James Veitch, I have an interesting business proposal I want to share with you, Solomon."
sentences.zh: （笑声）我知道。 （笑声）事情是这样的：“你好，詹姆斯·维奇，我有一个有趣的商业提案想与你分享，所罗门。”

sentences.en: Now, my hand was kind of hovering on the delete button, right?
sentences.zh: 现在，我的手悬停在删除按钮上，对吗？

sentences.en: I was looking at my phone. I thought, I could just delete this.
sentences.zh: 我正在看手机。我想，我可以删除这个。

sentences.en: Or I could do what I think we've all always wanted to do.
sentences.zh: 或者我可以做我认为我们都一直想做的事情。

sentences.en: (Laughter) And I said, "Solomon, Your email intrigues me."
sentences.zh: （笑声）我说：“所罗门，你的电子邮件引起了我的兴趣。”

sentences.en: (Laughter) (Applause) And the game was afoot.
sentences.zh: （笑声）（掌声）比赛正在进行中。

sentences.en: He said, "Dear James Veitch, We shall be shipping Gold to you."
sentences.zh: 他说：“亲爱的詹姆斯·维奇，我们将把黄金运送给您。”

sentences.en: (Laughter) "You will earn 10% of any gold you distributes."
sentences.zh: （笑声）“你将获得你所分配的黄金的 10%。”

sentences.en: (Laughter) So I knew I was dealing with a professional.
sentences.zh: （笑声）所以我知道我正在和一个专业人士打交道。

sentences.en: (Laughter) I said, "How much is it worth?"
sentences.zh: （笑声）我说：“值多少钱？”

sentences.en: He said, "We will start with smaller quantity," -- I was like, aww -- and then he said, "of 25 kgs.
sentences.zh: 他说，“我们将从较小的数量开始”——我当时想，哇——然后他说，“25 公斤。”

sentences.en: (Laughter) The worth should be about $2.5 million."
sentences.zh: （笑声）价值应该是250万美元左右。”

sentences.en: I said, "Solomon, if we're going to do it, let's go big.
sentences.zh: 我说：“所罗门，如果我们要做这件事，就要做大事。

sentences.en: (Applause) I can handle it. How much gold do you have?"
sentences.zh: （鼓掌）我能应付。你有多少金子？”

sentences.en: (Laughter) He said, "It is not a matter of how much gold I have, what matters is your capability of handling.
sentences.zh: （笑）他说：“这不是我有多少金子的问题，重要的是你的处理能力。

sentences.en: We can start with 50 kgs as trial shipment."
sentences.zh: 我们可以从 50 公斤开始试运。”

sentences.en: I said, "50 kgs? There's no point doing this at all unless you're shipping at least a metric ton."
sentences.zh: 我说，“50 公斤？除非你要运输至少一公吨，否则这样做根本没有意义。”

sentences.en: (Laughter) (Applause) He said, "What do you do for a living?"
sentences.zh: （笑声）（掌声）他说：“你以什么为生？”

sentences.en: (Laughter) I said, "I'm a hedge fund executive bank manager."
sentences.zh: （笑声）我说：“我是一名对冲基金执行银行经理。”

sentences.en: (Laughter) This isn't the first time I've shipped bullion, my friend, no no.
sentences.zh: （笑声）这不是我第一次运送金条，我的朋友，不不。

sentences.en: Then I started to panic. I was like, "Where are you based?"
sentences.zh: 然后我开始惊慌。我当时想，“你在哪里？”

sentences.en: I don't know about you, but I think if we're going via the postal service, it ought to be signed for.
sentences.zh: 我不了解你的情况，但我认为如果我们通过邮政服务，就应该签收。

sentences.en: That's a lot of gold." He said, "It will not be easy to convince my company to do larger quantity shipment."
sentences.zh: 这是很多黄金。”他说，“说服我的公司进行更大数量的发货并不容易。”

sentences.en: I said, "Solomon, I'm completely with you on this one.
sentences.zh: 我说：“所罗门，在这一点上我完全同意你的观点。

sentences.en: I'm putting together a visual for you to take into the board meeting.
sentences.zh: 我正在整理一个视觉效果供您在董事会会议上使用。

sentences.en: Hold tight." (Laughter) This is what I sent Solomon.
sentences.zh: 抓紧。”（笑声）这就是我发给所罗门的。

sentences.en: (Laughter) (Applause) I don't know if we have any statisticians in the house, but there's definitely something going on.
sentences.zh: （笑声）（掌声）我不知道我们家里是否有统计学家，但肯定有事情发生。

sentences.en: (Laughter) I said, "Solomon, attached to this email you'll find a helpful chart.
sentences.zh: （笑声）我说：“所罗门，在这封电子邮件的附件中，你会发现一张有用的图表。

sentences.en: I've had one of my assistants run the numbers.
sentences.zh: 我让我的一位助手负责统计数字。

sentences.en: (Laughter) We're ready for shipping as much gold as possible."
sentences.zh: （笑声）我们已经准备好运送尽可能多的黄金。”

sentences.en: There's always a moment where they try to tug your heartstrings, and this was it for Solomon.
sentences.zh: 总有那么一个时刻，他们试图触动你的心弦，而这就是所罗门的时刻。

sentences.en: He said, "I will be so much happy if the deal goes well, because I'm going to get a very good commission as well."
sentences.zh: 他说：“如果交易进展顺利，我会非常高兴，因为我也将获得非常好的佣金。”

sentences.en: And I said, "That's amazing, What are you going to spend your cut on?"
sentences.zh: 我说：“太棒了，你打算把这笔钱花在什么地方？”

sentences.en: And he said, "On RealEstate, what about you?"
sentences.zh: 他说：“在房地产方面，你呢？”

sentences.en: I thought about it for a long time. And I said, "One word; Hummus."
sentences.zh: 我想了很久。我说：“一句话；鹰嘴豆泥。”

sentences.en: (Laughter) "It's going places. (Laughter) I was in Sainsbury's the other day and there were like 30 different varieties.
sentences.zh: （笑声）“事情正在发生。 （笑声） 前几天我在 Sainsbury's，那里有大约 30 种不同的品种。

sentences.en: Also you can cut up carrots, and you can dip them.
sentences.zh: 你也可以把胡萝卜切碎，然后蘸着吃。

sentences.en: Have you ever done that, Solomon?" (Laughter) He said, "I have to go bed now."
sentences.zh: 你曾经这样做过吗，所罗门？”（笑声）他说，“我现在必须去睡觉了。”

sentences.en: (Laughter) (Applause) "Till morrow. Have sweet dream."
sentences.zh: （笑声）（掌声）“明天。祝你有个甜蜜的梦。”

sentences.en: I didn't know what to say! I said, "Bonsoir my golden nugget, bonsoir."
sentences.zh: 我不知道该说什么！我说：“晚安，我的金块，晚安。”

sentences.en: (Laughter) Guys, you have to understand, this had been going for, like, weeks, albeit hitherto the greatest weeks of my life, but I had to knock it on the head.
sentences.zh: （笑声）伙计们，你们必须明白，这种情况已经持续了几周，尽管这是我生命中迄今为止最伟大的几周，但我不得不把它敲在头上。

sentences.en: It was getting a bit out of hand. Friends were saying, "James, do you want to come for a drink?"
sentences.zh: 事情有点失控了。朋友们说：“詹姆斯，你想来喝一杯吗？”

sentences.en: I was like, "I can't, I'm expecting an email about some gold."
sentences.zh: 我当时想，“我不能，我在等一封关于黄金的电子邮件。”

sentences.en: So I figured I had to knock it on the head.
sentences.zh: 所以我想我必须敲它的头。

sentences.en: I had to take it to a ridiculous conclusion.
sentences.zh: 我不得不得出一个荒谬的结论。

sentences.en: So I concocted a plan. I said, "Solomon, I'm concerned about security.
sentences.zh: 所以我制定了一个计划。我说：“所罗门，我担心安全问题。

sentences.en: When we email each other, we need to use a code."
sentences.zh: 当我们互相发送电子邮件时，我们需要使用代码。”

sentences.en: And he agreed. (Laughter) I said, "Solomon, I spent all night coming up with this code we need to use in all further correspondence: Lawyer: Gummy Bear.
sentences.zh: 他同意了。 （笑声）我说：“所罗门，我花了一整夜的时间想出这个代码，我们需要在所有进一步的通信中使用：律师：小熊软糖。

sentences.en: Bank: Cream Egg. Legal: Fizzy Cola Bottle. Claim: Peanut M&Ms.
sentences.zh: 银行：奶油蛋。合法：碳酸可乐瓶。声称：花生巧克力豆。

sentences.en: Documents: Jelly Beans. Western Union: A Giant Gummy Lizard."
sentences.zh: 文件：果冻豆。西联汇款：巨型软糖蜥蜴。”

sentences.en: (Laughter) I knew these were all words they use, right?
sentences.zh: （笑声）我知道这些都是他们用的词，对吧？

sentences.en: I said, "Please call me Kitkat in all further correspondence."
sentences.zh: 我说：“在以后的通信中请叫我 Kitkat。”

sentences.en: (Laughter) I didn't hear back. I thought, I've gone too far.
sentences.zh: （笑声）我没有收到回复。我想，我已经走得太远了。

sentences.en: I've gone too far. So I had to backpedal a little.
sentences.zh: 我已经走得太远了。所以我不得不稍微退一步。

sentences.en: I said, "Solomon, Is the deal still on? KitKat."
sentences.zh: 我说：“所罗门，交易还在继续吗？KitKat。”

sentences.en: (Laughter) Because you have to be consistent.
sentences.zh: （笑声）因为你必须保持一致。

sentences.en: Then I did get an email back from him. He said, "The Business is on and I am trying to blah ..."
sentences.zh: 然后我确实收到了他的回复电子邮件。他说：“生意还在继续，我正试图胡说八道……”

sentences.en: I said, "Dude, you have to use the code!"
sentences.zh: 我说：“伙计，你必须使用密码！”

sentences.en: What followed is the greatest email I've ever received.
sentences.zh: 接下来是我收到过的最棒的电子邮件。

sentences.en: (Laughter) I'm not joking, this is what turned up in my inbox.
sentences.zh: （笑声）我不是在开玩笑，这就是我收件箱中出现的内容。

sentences.en: This was a good day. "The business is on.
sentences.zh: 这是美好的一天。 “生意还在进行中。

sentences.en: I am trying to raise the balance for the Gummy Bear -- (Laughter) so he can submit all the needed Fizzy Cola Bottle Jelly Beans to the Creme Egg, for the Peanut M&Ms process to start.
sentences.zh: 我正在努力提高小熊软糖的余额（笑声），这样他就可以将所有需要的碳酸可乐瓶果冻豆提交给奶油蛋，以便启动花生巧克力豆加工过程。

sentences.en: (Laughter) Send 1,500 pounds via a Giant Gummy Lizard."
sentences.zh: （笑声）通过巨型软糖蜥蜴发送 1,500 磅。”

sentences.en: (Applause) And that was so much fun, right,
sentences.zh: （鼓掌）那真是太有趣了，对吧，

sentences.en: that it got me thinking: like, what would happen if I just spent as much time as could replying to as many scam emails as I could?
sentences.zh: 这让我开始思考：如果我花尽可能多的时间回复尽可能多的诈骗电子邮件，会发生什么？

sentences.en: And that's what I've been doing for three years on your behalf.
sentences.zh: 这就是我三年来为你们所做的事情。

sentences.en: (Laughter) (Applause) Crazy stuff happens when you start replying to scam emails.
sentences.zh: （笑声）（掌声）当你开始回复诈骗电子邮件时，疯狂的事情就会发生。

sentences.en: It's really difficult, and I highly recommend we do it.
sentences.zh: 这确实很难，我强烈建议我们这样做。

sentences.en: I don't think what I'm doing is mean. There are a lot of people who do mean things to scammers.
sentences.zh: 我不认为我所做的事是卑鄙的。有很多人对诈骗者做出卑鄙的事情。

sentences.en: All I'm doing is wasting their time. And I think any time they're spending with me is time they're not spending scamming vulnerable adults out of their savings, right?
sentences.zh: 我所做的一切都是在浪费他们的时间。我认为他们和我一起度过的任何时间都是他们不会花在骗取弱势成年人的积蓄上的时间，对吧？

sentences.en: And if you're going to do this -- and I highly recommend you do -- get yourself a pseudonymous email address.
sentences.zh: 如果您打算这样做（我强烈建议您这样做），请为自己获取一个假名电子邮件地址。

sentences.en: Don't use your own email address. That's what I was doing at the start and it was a nightmare.
sentences.zh: 不要使用您自己的电子邮件地址。这就是我一开始所做的，那是一场噩梦。

sentences.en: I'd wake up in the morning and have a thousand emails about penis enlargements, only one of which was a legitimate response -- (Laughter) to a medical question I had.
sentences.zh: 我早上醒来时会收到一千封有关阴茎增大的电子邮件，其中只有一封是对我提出的医疗问题的合理答复（笑声）。

sentences.en: But I'll tell you what, though, guys, I'll tell you what: any day is a good day, any day is a good day if you receive an email that begins like this: (Laughter) "I AM WINNIE MANDELA,
sentences.zh: 但我要告诉你们的是，伙计们，我要告诉你们的是：任何一天都是美好的一天，如果你们收到一封这样开头的电子邮件，任何一天都是美好的一天：（笑声）“我是温妮·曼德拉，

sentences.en: THE SECOND WIFE OF NELSON MANDELA THE FORMER SOUTH AFRICAN PRESIDENT."
sentences.zh: 南非前总统纳尔逊·曼德拉的第二任妻子。”

sentences.en: I was like, oh! -- that Winnie Mandela. (Laughter) I know so many.
sentences.zh: 我当时想，哦！ ——那个温妮·曼德拉。 （笑声）我认识很多。

sentences.en: "I NEED TO TRANSFER 45 MILLION DOLLARS OUT OF THE COUNTRY BECAUSE OF MY HUSBAND NELSON MANDELA'S HEALTH CONDITION."
sentences.zh: “由于我丈夫纳尔逊·曼德拉的健康状况，我需要将 4500 万美元转出国外。”

sentences.en: Let that sink in. She sent me this, which is hysterical.
sentences.zh: 让我们理解这一点。她给我发了这个，这太歇斯底里了。

sentences.en: (Laughter) And this. And this looks fairly legitimate, this is a letter of authorization.
sentences.zh: （笑声）还有这个。这看起来相当合法，这是一封授权书。

sentences.en: But to be honest, if there's nothing written on it, it's just a shape!
sentences.zh: 但说实话，如果上面什么都没有写的话，那就只是一个形状而已！

sentences.en: (Laughter) I said, "Winnie, I'm really sorry to hear of this.
sentences.zh: （笑声）我说：“温妮，听到这个消息我真的很难过。

sentences.en: Given that Nelson died three months ago, I'd describe his health condition as fairly serious."
sentences.zh: 鉴于尼尔森三个月前去世，我认为他的健康状况相当严重。”

sentences.en: (Laughter) That's the worst health condition you can have, not being alive.
sentences.zh: （笑声） 那是最糟糕的健康状况，不是活着。

sentences.en: She said, "KINDLY COMPLY WITH MY BANKERS INSTRUCTIONS.
sentences.zh: 她说：“请遵守我的银行家指示。

sentences.en: ONE LOVE." (Laughter) I said, "Of course. NO WOMAN, NO CRY."
sentences.zh: 一份爱。” （笑声）我说：“当然。女人不许哭。”

sentences.en: (Laughter) (Applause) She said, "MY BANKER WILL NEED TRANSFER OF 3000 DOLLARS. ONE LOVE."
sentences.zh: （笑声）（掌声）她说：“我的银行家需要转账 3000 美元。一份爱。”

sentences.en: (Laughter) I said, "no problemo. I SHOT THE SHERIFF."
sentences.zh: （笑声）我说：“没问题。我射杀了警长。”

sentences.en: [ (BUT I DID NOT SHOOT THE DEPUTY) ] (Laughter) Thank you.
sentences.zh: [（但我没有射杀副手）]（笑声）谢谢。

sentences.en: (Applause)
sentences.zh: （掌声）
